svg.title: MMLE–EM Learning Lab interface design preview
svg.desc: Proposed Streamlit layout with global settings at left, response-generation controls at left, six tabs at top including result validation, and equation/explanation/notation controls, and an E-step walkthrough with likelihood, prior and posterior views. All curves are schematic; no estimates were computed.

g.text: Understand how responses, population weights, and calibration constraints work together.
True a / b / c · c for 3PL only
Same engine, different fixed / shared / free constraints.
Current example: standard calibration · 2PL · fixed normal population · no item priors
How well does each ability explain the answers?
How much population mass is at each node?
Combine and normalize to sum to one
One equation at a time · expand derivation
Posterior weight = likelihood × population weight / total weighted likelihood
Primary validation: irtQ agreement · Not run
Not run · bias / RMSE across replications
Not run · anchors, weights, and convergence
Current: pure MMLE · a/b unbounded · c fixed 0 (2PL) · edits require a new fit
No guessing prior is applied in 2PL
Reset keeps c fixed at 0 in 2PL; guessing-prior defaults apply only in 3PL. Bank anchors stay locked.
Static design preview. Estimator, animations, and validation are planned; no results or validation checks have been computed.
